title: Product inventory table with inline price/stock editing and per-row save
notes: v2 is a Tailwind rewrite: price inputs move into <sr-money-field> and stock inputs into <sr-stepper> web components with declarative shadow roots (ids/names dropped), 'Stock' becomes 'On hand' with new 'Available' and 'Committed' columns, the SKU folds into the product cell, rows are re-sorted by Available, the Low-stock badge moves to the Available column, 'Reset' becomes an icon-only 'Discard changes' button, data-testids and data-sku disappear, and decoys are added: a sticky unsaved-changes bar (Save/Discard), a low-stock alert card linking the same product names first, and a hidden bulk-edit drawer with another Price field and Save button. The table id survives, so the positional Save XPath hits another product's Save.
